payload.text: Raft persistent-state corruption safety (deliverable: replog-quorum-durability). persist::decode is a pure, deterministic deserializer: given a byte slice it validates exact RECORD_LEN, recomputes crc32 over the body and rejects any mismatch by returning None, then reconstructs (current_term, voted_for, commit_index) with no I/O and no mutation of any shared state. Purity + CRC validation is the safety invariant — a torn or bit-flipped persisted vote/term/commit record can never be silently accepted, so quorum-commit durability and single-vote-per-term election safety survive a crash mid-fsync. Pure (no WRITES edges); self-invalidates on change.
